Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.persistence.repository.messaging

Interface KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>
@Repository public interface KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity,UUID>
Coordinates notification outbox lookup, worker claims, retry scheduling, and delivery state.

Due-query methods select eligible or abandoned leases; fenced update methods compare the current status and claim token so an old worker cannot overwrite the result of a newer claim. The unfenced variants support legacy delivery paths and should be used only when caller serialization guarantees exclusive ownership.

    • claimFenced

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = \'PROCESSING\', o.claimedBy = :workerId,\n o.claimedUntil = :claimedUntil, o.claimToken = :claimToken,\n o.attempts = o.attempts + 1\nwhere o.id = :id\n and ((o.status in :dueStatuses and (o.nextAttemptAt is null or o.nextAttemptAt <= :now))\n or (o.status = \'PROCESSING\' and (o.claimedUntil is null or o.claimedUntil <= :now)))\n") int claimFenced(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("dueStatuses") Collection<String> dueStatuses, @Param("now") Instant now, @Param("workerId") String workerId, @Param("claimToken") UUID claimToken, @Param("claimedUntil") Instant claimedUntil)
      Claims a due or expired row using a fencing token and increments its attempt count.
      Parameters:
      id - outbox row to claim
      dueStatuses - states eligible for a new attempt
      now - current instant for the due/expired checks
      workerId - identity of the worker acquiring the claim
      claimToken - fresh token required for subsequent fenced updates
      claimedUntil - lease expiration instant assigned to the worker
      Returns:
      one if this worker atomically acquired the claim, otherwise zero

    • markRetryableFailure

      @Modifying @Query("update KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = :status,\n o.attempts = o.attempts + 1,\n o.nextAttemptAt = :nextAttemptAt,\n o.lastError = :lastError,\n o.claimedBy = null,\n o.claimedUntil = null\nwhere o.id = :id\n") int markRetryableFailure(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("status") String status, @Param("nextAttemptAt") Instant nextAttemptAt, @Param("lastError") String lastError)
      Records a retryable failure using a caller-selected retry state and schedule.

      This compatibility path is not fenced by a claim token; callers must ensure exclusive ownership before using it.

      Parameters:
      id - outbox row that failed
      status - retryable state to persist
      nextAttemptAt - absolute instant when another attempt becomes due
      lastError - failure detail retained for operations
      Returns:
      number of rows updated

      @Modifying(clearAutomatically=true, flushAutomatically=true) @Query("update KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = \'FAILED_RETRYABLE\', o.nextAttemptAt = :nextAttemptAt,\n o.lastError = :lastError, o.claimedBy = null, o.claimedUntil = null,\n o.claimToken = null\nwhere o.id = :id and o.status = \'PROCESSING\' and o.claimToken = :claimToken\n") int markRetryableFailureFenced(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("claimToken") UUID claimToken, @Param("nextAttemptAt") Instant nextAttemptAt, @Param("lastError") String lastError)
      Records a retryable failure only when the row remains in processing under this token.
      Parameters:

      claimToken - current worker token proving ownership
      nextAttemptAt - next eligible retry instant
      lastError - failure detail retained for operations
      Returns:

    • markFinalFailure

      @Modifying @Query("update KfeFinancialNotificationOutboxEntity o\nset o.status = :status,\n o.lastError = :lastError,\n o.claimedBy = null,\n o.claimedUntil = null\nwhere o.id = :id\n") int markFinalFailure(@Param("id") UUID id, @Param("status") String status, @Param("lastError") String lastError)
      Marks a row as finally failed and releases its legacy claim fields.

      This compatibility operation has no fencing token and therefore relies on caller-side exclusive ownership.

      Parameters:
      id - outbox row with terminal failure
      status - terminal state to persist
      lastError - final failure detail
      Returns:
      number of rows updated
